{{Quote|The Twin Suns pirates have been harassing us since the day I became mayor. And now they want to take our mine--ninety percent of this town works that mine!|[[Jundo Martik]]|<ref name="TOR:RtW" />}}
The '''Twin Suns mining compound''' was a mining compound located in the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] that was run by the [[Twin Suns (pirates)|Twin Suns]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] group. Originally owned and operated by the people of the nearby [[Outpost Salara]], the compound was overrun by the pirates during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="TOR:RtW" /> The compound included [[Twin Suns Station (Tatooine)|Twin Suns Station]] and the [[Twin Suns Mine]].<ref name="TOR:QQ" />
